title: Quantum Computing
description: A register of n qubits holds all 2ⁿ of its values at once; a quantum algorithm makes the wrong answers cancel. Grover's search finds one marked item among N in about (π/4)·√N steps, where a classical search needs N/2; but every gate must be faultless enough that the whole circuit keeps its coherence, so the qubits are cooled to a hundredth of a degree. Unlocks the Quantum Computer: each run shortens your current study by fifteen minutes.

puzzle.goal: Grover's search among N items needs about (π/4)·√N oracle calls. Write the speed-up S over a classical search, which needs N/2 on average.
puzzle.name: Grover's speed-up
puzzle.method: Divide the classical expected count by the quantum one; it grows as √N.
